body.purpose: All body text, card content, form labels. 16px floor.

title.purpose: Page and section headings. One level only.

label.purpose: Meta text, dates, language tags, tab labels.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card lift on hover only. No static shadows.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, active).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink-blue button for the single primary action on screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2c3e5a; color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a2d44; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c3e5a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent secondary button for Cancel, Back, or inline actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6b6b6b; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e5e5e5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c3e5a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Container for translation list items or content sections. Flat at rest with border separation.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #ccc; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with clean border treatment.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b6b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2c3e5a; outline: 2px solid #2c3e5a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Horizontal tab switcher with bottom-border active indicator.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e5e5; gap: 0; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6b6b6b; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab.active { color: #2c3e5a; border-bottom-color: #2c3e5a; } .ds-tab:hover:not(.active) { color: #1a1a1a; }

components.name: Toast
components.css: .ds-toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; z-index: 1000; opacity: 1; transition: opacity 250ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-toast.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Lightbox Overlay
components.description: Fullscreen image viewer, tap to dismiss.
components.css: .ds-lightbox { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 999; padding: 32px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lightbox.hidden { display: none; } .ds-lightbox img { max-width: 95vw; max-height: 95vh; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-lightbox-close { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 24px; color: #fff; font-size: 2rem; cursor: pointer; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

narrative.overview:
A digital notebook that stays out of the way. Like a well-made paper notebook — clean pages, clear ink, no decoration — this interface serves one purpose: to help you review translations and learn from them. The UI is a container, not a participant.

The system is monochrome-restrained: grayscale with a single muted blue accent that evokes fountain pen ink. No gradients, no loud shadows, no colorful badges. Everything on screen must justify itself. Typography does the heavy lifting — Inter, a workhorse sans-serif with excellent legibility at small sizes and clean proportions at display sizes.

This is a tool for one person. It doesn't need to impress; it needs to be clear, fast, and invisible. The best compliment is that you forget about the interface entirely.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome at rest, a single ink-blue accent on interaction
Typography-driven hierarchy; color is a signal, not decoration
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; no floating shadows
Dense but breathable — information-rich without feeling cramped
Mobile-first with desktop as a wider canvas, not a different design

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ink Blue appears on ≤5% of any screen. Links, the active tab underline, the primary button. If you see blue in three places at once, something is over-signaling.

rules.name: The No Tint Rule
rules.body: Paper is achromatic — zero chroma, no warm or cool bias. The notebook is blank; the content provides the color.

rules.name: The Single Weight Jump Rule
rules.body: Title to Body is 400→600 weight and 1.25rem→1rem size. One step each. More contrast than that and the page starts shouting.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only as a response to interaction. No ambient/diffuse shadows. If it's not being interacted with, it's flat.

dos: Do use the system font stack as the first render; Inter loads as enhancement
Do keep spacing in multiples of 4px (4, 8, 16, 24, 32)
Do use 1px borders for separation instead of shadows
Do ensure every interactive element has a 44px minimum touch target
Do set font-size: 16px on all inputs to prevent iOS zoom
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative blur
Don't use box-shadow + 1px border together on cards at rest (the ghost-card pattern)
Don't round cards beyond 14px or buttons beyond 8px
Don't use the Pico.css default blue (#1095c1) — too saturated for this system
Don't add SaaS landing-page clichés: hero metrics, gradient CTAs, numbered section markers, tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows
Don't use warm-tinted backgrounds (cream, sand, beige, paper-like warm tones). The Paper neutral is achromatic
Don't add emoji as icons in the UI. Use text labels or a consistent SVG icon set
Don't add more than one primary button per screen
